candidate_windows.window_text: All of our models are binary RoBERTa-based classifiers trained with the default settings of the Trainer module from the Huggingface library for 3 training epochs, on a Tesla V100-SXM2 GPU machine, batch size of 16, warm-up steps of 500 and weight decay of 0.01. We use Roberta-base model, which includes 12 layers, 768 hidden nodes, 12 head nodes, 125M parameters, and add a linear layer with two nodes for binary classification. Training these classifiers takes several hours depending on the size of the training dataset.
